title: COCOA-SHELLS
instructions: Cocoa-shells are the thin outer covering of the beans. They have a flavor similar to but milder than cocoa. Their very
low price places them within the reach of all; and as furnishing a pleasant and healthy drink, they are considered superior to tea and coffee.
Packed only in 1 lb. and 1/2 lb. papers, with our label and name on them.
